candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Tagjaink (member bank directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical enumeration of ~67 Hungarian credit institutions (full members, associated members, observers incl. GIRO Zrt., Magyar Államkincstár, OBA, Diákhitel Központ). Cheapest single expansion of the banking entity universe for every other A5 cell; each member has a detail page (tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=NN) that yields the institution's own site and contact person.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly HTML scrape of tagjaink.cshtml plus enumeration of tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=* detail pages; diff member set to detect entries/exits (M&A, licence changes).
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search + direct fetch of association site
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség elnökség tagok listája választás

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Szervezet (Elnökség / governance pages)
candidates.why_relevant: Names the Association's own presidency and supervisory board — each seat is held by a named senior executive of a named bank (e.g. president from Erste, vice-president from OTP Jelzálogbank, FB chair from K&H, members from CIB, UniCredit, Raiffeisen, MBH, Gránit, ING, Bank of China, Citibank branch, GIRO). Triennial tisztújítás makes this a dated leadership-move signal AND a who-runs-which-bank cross-reference.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot + diff of /szervezet/* pages; escalate around the 3-yearly general assembly (May cycle observed 2020, 2023).
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu search snowball from member-list page
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség elnökség tagok listája választás
"Magyar Bankszövetség" főtitkár kinevezés Kovács Levente sajtóközlemény

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Sajtóközlemények / Kommunikék / Hírek
candidates.why_relevant: Primary, dated publication channel for the association's own election results, secretary-general appointments, working-group leadership and joint-initiative staffing (e.g. KiberPajzs with MNB/NMHH/NBSZ-NKI/ORFK). Beats media reporting by hours-to-days and carries exact Hungarian titles.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly list-page scrape of sajtokozlemenyek.cshtml, kommunikek.cshtml and hirek-aktualitasok; keyword filter on kinevez*, megválaszt*, tisztújítás, elnök, főtitkár, távoz*, lemond*.
queries_used: "Magyar Bankszövetség" főtitkár kinevezés Kovács Levente sajtóközlemény

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Munkacsoportok (working groups)
candidates.why_relevant: Working groups (payments, cards, IT/cyber, compliance, etc.) are chaired by named bank specialists — a directory of mid-level subject-matter owners across all member banks. Very high value for A5 'who does what' mapping, since these names are the practical counterparties for payments/vendor topics and their rotation signals internal reorganisations.
candidates.access_status: open web (some contact detail may be members-only)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual scrape and diff of the working-group index and sub-pages.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség elnökség tagok listája választás

candidates.source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség (MAFISZ / Hungarian Fintech Association) — tagok + igazgatóság
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the ~30+ Hungarian fintech / payment-institution / regtech companies (e.g. Barion, Dorsum, SEON) that no bank-centric list captures, and the homepage names the board (elnök Ács Zoltán; board incl. Barion founder-CEO Kiss Sándor; főtitkár dr. Urbán Viktor). Two-year board mandates give a recurring leadership-move event.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of /hu/tagok/ and homepage board block; diff member roster and board names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu search then direct fetch (member/board URLs confirmed on page)
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagjai elnök

candidates.source_name: IVSZ — Szövetség a Digitális Gazdaságért: tagvállalatok + szervezeti felépítés
candidates.why_relevant: The ICT-industry association's member directory is the vendor-side counterpart to the bank list — it includes fintech and payments vendors (individual member profile pages, e.g. /tagvallalatok/zelig-fintech/). Its Fintech Munkacsoport and its elnökség elections (SME / micro / startup-scaleup seats) are documented on-site.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of /tagok/ (paginated) + /szervezet/ + /cimke/fintech/ news tag; diff rosters and board.
queries_used: IVSZ tagvállalatok lista fintech pénzforgalom elnökség

candidates.source_name: AmCham Hungary — Board of Directors & committee structure
candidates.why_relevant: Annual (December) general-assembly board elections are published with full name/title/company for each director and the supervisory board chair (2024 cycle: president Ákos Janza, MSCI; directors incl. Morgan Stanley Hungary Analytics' head of risk). AmCham committees are the venue where financial-services country managers surface publicly, so committee pages act as a pointer to FS leadership.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape board page quarterly plus /media/amcham-news feed monthly; heavy pass each December after the General Assembly.

candidates.source_name: HBLF — Hungarian Business Leaders Forum: elnökség + member companies
candidates.why_relevant: Board seats are filled by named senior executives of member corporations, and the member-company directory contains bank entries with their own profile pages (e.g. ING Bank N.V. Magyarországi Fióktelepe). A public call for nominations for the president and 5 board seats expiring in 2026 was observed — a scheduled, trackable leadership event.
candidates.access_status: open web; legacy query-string CMS, URLs are fragile
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual crawl following searchenginerUrl parameters from the homepage rather than storing deep links; re-resolve paths each run. Watch 2026 nomination/election cycle.
queries_used: HBLF Hungarian Business Leaders Forum elnökség tagvállalatok bank

candidates.source_name: Magyar Lízingszövetség (Hungarian Leasing Association) — Kik vagyunk? + hírek
candidates.why_relevant: ~36 asset-finance member companies — bank-owned leasing arms (Merkantil/OTP, Raiffeisen Corporate Leasing, MKB-Euroleasing, SG Eszközfinanszírozás, Ayvens/LeasePlan) that are invisible in the banking-association list. Publishes its own board changes as dated news items (e.g. 'Új alelnök és elnökségi tagok a Magyar Lízingszövetségnél'), and each board seat identifies a named executive's current employer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of /kik-vagyunk (members + elnökség) and /hirek; keyword filter on elnök, alelnök, elnökségi tag.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu search; also surfaced as an associated member of Magyar Bankszövetség (snowball)

candidates.source_name: MABISZ — Magyar Biztosítók Szövetsége (governance + members)
candidates.why_relevant: Adjacent-sector body (~30 insurers, many bancassurance partners of HU banks). Elects an eight-member elnökség which then elects president/vice-president (March 2025: NN's Holló Bence replacing Generali's Erdős Mihály) — a clean, dated leadership-move stream naming insurer CEOs. Its published Alapszabály documents the election mechanics and cadence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of the about/governance and news sections; parse the Alapszabály PDF once to model term lengths.
queries_used: "Magyar Lízingszövetség" OR "Magyar Biztosítók Szövetsége" OR "Takarékszövetkezetek" elnök megválasztás tagok

negative_findings.description: No dedicated SZÉP-card issuers' association or 'Magyar Utalványkibocsátók Egyesülete' could be located. Hungarian searches surfaced only issuer product pages (OTP, K&H, MBH) and the BFKH/MKEH regulatory register of SZÉP-card acceptance, plus the rule that since 2018 only payment service providers may issue SZÉP cards.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's seed assumption of a 'Magyar SZÉP/kártyaszövetség' is not supported by evidence; the issuer set appears to be governed via MNB/BFKH registers and the Bankszövetség rather than a standalone trade body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated association entry and redirects SZÉP/benefit-card entity discovery to the BFKH register and to bank issuer newsrooms (cell overlap with registry/regulator cells).

negative_findings.description: AmCham Hungary's Financial Services / banking committee chairperson was not identifiable from public search. The board of directors is published with names and companies, but committee leadership was not exposed in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Board-level leadership is trackable; committee-level FS leadership is not, from search alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Committee chairs are exactly the mid-senior FS names A5 wants; a direct crawl of amcham.hu committee pages (or the member magazine) is needed rather than search-engine discovery.

negative_findings.description: No distinct Hungarian association was found for savings cooperatives ('takarékszövetkezetek') as a live body — the sector consolidated into MBH Bank, so the historic OTSZ/Takarékbank interest-representation layer appears defunct.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'takarékszövetkezetek elnök megválasztás tagok' returned no current association; only MABISZ and leasing results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids scheduling collection against a body that likely no longer exists; historic references in older documents should be resolved to MBH Bank.

negative_findings.description: The Blockchain Koalíció (formed 8 March 2022 by the innovation ministry and the national data-economy knowledge centre) has no standalone portal discoverable via search; only trade-press interviews name its chair.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Its membership would enumerate DLT/payments actors with state ties; the absence of a primary source caps confidence in anything attributed to it.

negative_findings.description: None of the core association sites (bankszovetseg.hu, hunfintech.com, lizingszovetseg.hu, hblf.hu) advertised an RSS/Atom feed or an API in what was observed; bankszovetseg.hu and hblf.hu use legacy query-string CMS URLs (.cshtml?lang=hun, index.php?searchenginerUrl=...).
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be HTML scraping with diffing, not feed subscription; deep links are fragile.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering expectations and warns that stored deep links will rot — crawls should re-resolve from site roots.

coverage_gaps.description: Member rosters for IVSZ (/tagok/), MAFISZ (/hu/tagok/), Magyar Lízingszövetség and MAKISZ were identified but their full contents were not enumerated in this pass; the Bankszövetség roster was read only in summary (~67 entries, exact names not fully captured).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated enumeration pass that fetches each roster page (and its pagination) and emits a normalised entity table with member name, member class (full/associate/observer) and home URL.

coverage_gaps.description: The mid-level committee/working-group layer (Bankszövetség munkacsoportok, IVSZ Fintech Munkacsoport, AmCham committees, JVSZ working groups) is where payments and IT decision-makers are named, but only the index pages were located, not the chair lists.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deep-crawl each association's committee sub-pages directly (not via search engines) and extract chair/secretary name + employer.

coverage_gaps.description: Only AmCham, BCCH and DUIHK/AHK were touched. Not examined: MKIK (Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara) and its Budapest chapter BKIK, Joint Venture Szövetség (JVSZ) own site, French/Italian/Dutch/Nordic chambers, and the Hungarian Chamber of Auditors (MKVK) which governs bank auditors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a chamber sweep: mkik.hu, bkik.hu, jvsz.hu, mkvk.hu — each for board/committee pages and member directories.

coverage_gaps.description: Market-infrastructure and capital-market bodies with governance publications were not covered: GIRO Zrt., KELER/KELER KSZF, Budapesti Értéktőzsde (BÉT), Országos Betétbiztosítási Alap (OBA), Befektető-védelmi Alap (BEVA), Bankkártya Szövetség-type card bodies.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated infrastructure sweep; note GIRO and OBA already appear as Bankszövetség observers, so the member list is the entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: Association governance changes are legally filed with the Hungarian courts (civil-organisation register, birosag.hu / Országos Bírósági Hivatal civil szervezetek névjegyzéke), which would give authoritative dated officer changes. This registry route was not explored in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test birosag.hu civil-organisation search for Magyar Bankszövetség, MAFISZ, Lízingszövetség etc. to obtain filed officer records as a ground-truth layer.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice has been verified as reachable; several (hblf.hu, bcch.com, makisz.hu, blockchainhungary.org) use legacy or query-string URL schemes with elevated rot risk, and amcham.hu/bbj.hu may be partly gated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic liveness pass; on 403/timeout re-test with a browser agent before marking anything dead.

brief: Hungary's banking/payments association layer is small, highly concentrated and unusually generous with named-person data: Magyar Bankszövetség is the anchor, publishing both a ~67-entry member roster (banks, branches, plus observers such as GIRO, the State Treasury and OBA) and a governance section in which every presidency and supervisory-board seat is tied to a named executive at a named bank on a three-year tisztújítás cycle. Around it sit complementary rosters that no bank-centric list captures — MAFISZ/hunfintech.com for fintechs and PSPs, IVSZ for IT and payments vendors, Magyar Lízingszövetség for bank-owned asset-finance arms, MABISZ for bancassurance partners, MAKISZ for NPL servicers — making this cell the cheapest entity-universe expansion available to the whole run. The chamber layer (AmCham, BCCH, DUIHK, HBLF) adds annual, English-language board elections that double as executive-move signals, with BBJ's Chamber of Commerce Corner acting as a single aggregating monitor. Practical constraints: no RSS or APIs were observed, several sites use fragile legacy query-string URLs, the committee/working-group layer where the most operationally relevant names live is not search-engine visible and needs direct crawling, and one seed assumption — a Hungarian SZÉP-card issuers' association — could not be substantiated at all.
